span.p: A gene: all its isoforms pooled

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(27, 58, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2 · The gene set's own name (RefSeq / Ensembl),
or a naming species: its OMA 1:1 / many:1 ortholog,
else a full-length reciprocal best hit,
else (another species only) a full-length best hit?

div.style: color: rgb(27, 58, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Its name; another species' name ends '-like (label)'
SRC / ISO / ISS

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Transposable-element domain AND
OMA pairs ≥ 5 copies here with one human gene?

div.style: color: rgb(27, 58, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3 · OMA human ortholog?
pairwise (tier 1) or HOG (tier 2)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Prepare OMA's set
· readthroughs and other Ensembl models of one gene not counted
· pairwise 1 gene but HOG several → the HOG's family

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Supported? a hit to one of the human genes
(any coverage) or a shared PANTHER family

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Evidence against it?
· best hit another gene AND PANTHER family differs → omaC
· ≥ 5 copies paired, fewer than half pass → omaR
· this gene spans both halves of a readthrough (fused model?)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(27, 58, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
'SYMBOL: approved name'
'(1 of N)' when N copies here carry it
ISO · 1to1 / Nto1

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Shared HGNC group that is a family by descent?
(PANTHER coherence ≥ 0.6)

div.style: color: rgb(27, 58, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
'<HGNC group> family member' · no symbol
ISO · fam

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Shared PANTHER family, and the gene a whole member?
(≥ 50% of the model, or a full-length hit to a member)

div.style: color: rgb(27, 58, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
7 · PANTHER family covering ≥ 75% of its model?
(≥ 80% by protein residues when there is no InterProScan JSON)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5 · PANTHER tree: a trusted placement with exactly one human
ortholog, which is also the closest human gene by similarity
(RBH, via another species, or best hit — one gene, not a family)?

div.style: color: rgb(27, 58, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
6 · Best human hit full-length?
(E ≤ 1e-10, ≥ 80% of both proteins; the top hit only)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Another human gene within 5% of its bitscore?

div.style: color: rgb(27, 58, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Exactly one tied gene a full-length
reciprocal best hit?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Shared HGNC group (family by descent)
or PANTHER family?

div.style: color: rgb(27, 58, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
'<group or family> family member'
ISS · tie-grp

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(27, 58, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(27, 58, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
'<family> family member'
InterPro's name, or PANTHER's when InterPro's describes a function
ISM · pthr

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
8 · InterPro Domain or Repeat (not DUF / UPF / uncharacterised),
covering ≥ 50% of its model where known?

span.p: None: hits did not pass the naming tests
